# Dim's Desktop - Interactive Retro Portfolio
# https://andimsum.icu

## About This Site
This is the personal portfolio website of Muhammad Ahsan Sanadi (also known as "Andi" or "Dim"), 
a tech enthusiast and aspiring DevOps engineer from Yogyakarta, Indonesia.

The website is designed as an interactive retro operating system interface, 
inspired by Windows 98 and Xfce.

## Owner Information
- Name: Muhammad Ahsan Sanadi
- Location: Yogyakarta, Indonesia
- Email: ahsansanadi167@gmail.com
- GitHub: https://github.com/AkuSeorangManusia
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/andimsum/
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/andimsum_
- Blog: https://blog.andimsum.icu

## Site Features
- Interactive desktop interface with draggable windows
- About Me section with personal information
- Projects showcase
- Contact information
- Guestbook
- Blog integration
- Calculator tool
- Discord presence widget

## Technical Details
- Built with Next.js
- Uses React for interactive components
- Styled with Tailwind CSS
- VT323 retro font for authentic feel
